My name is Dr Ruben Mesa and I’m a hematologic oncologist.
Today, I’d like to talk about how I manage anemia in my patients with myelofibrosis, whether it be disease- or treatment-related.
We know that patients with myelofibrosis require active management at the time of diagnosis. Many clinicians may have concerns about initiating Jakafi therapy in patients with anemia. However, anemia is not a reason for me to delay treatment with Jakafi in appropriate patients.
